headline: Iran's 7 conditions for peace talks, listed by Araghchi'

sources: Al Jazeera liveblog, 'What are Iran's 7 conditions for peace talks?' (03:45 GMT Nov 2), relaying FM Abbas Araghchi to legislators + security chief Mohsen Rezaei (September)
fault_line: Is Tehran's price a real off-ramp or a list designed to be refused? Sanctions relief + a recognised Iran-set Hormuz route vs Washington's post-midterm strike option.

sections.what_happened: Iran insists the US meet seven conditions before Hormuz reopens and peace talks begin. Araghchi's list (Saturday): (1) lift sanctions imposed after the July Islamabad MoU collapse; (2) reduce US military presence in the region; (3) reinstate June oil waivers granted under the MoU; (4) release frozen Iranian funds including those held in Qatar; (5) formally recognise the Iran/Oman-set shipping route in Hormuz and close all other routes; (6) end the war on all fronts, particularly Israel's attacks on Lebanon. Rezaei's September additions (end of US naval blockade of Iranian ports; end of US interference in internal affairs) make up the seventh strand. Context in same liveblog (03:00 GMT): Doha talks day 3 centred on a two-day Hormuz reopening plan conditional on these demands.
sections.what_verified: AJ liveblog relay of Araghchi/Rezaei statements; consistent with earlier scan records of the Doha two-day plan and MoU conditions.
sections.what_disputed: No US acceptance or response to the conditions reported; Araghchi himself said no final agreement reached and progress depends on Washington answering Iran's questions. The '7 conditions' framing bundles Araghchi's six with Rezaei's September additions; AJ does not present a single written Iranian document listing all seven.
sections.why_matters: Iran just published its price for peace — seven conditions, one strait. Lead with the list, then the fault line: who blinks first, Tehran or Washington after Tuesday?
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (AJ liveblog 03:45 GMT = 07:45 ) -- Iran's 7 conditions for peace talks, listed by Araghchi
